study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective database
exposure: Pregnant women without a previous vaginal delivery
Mode of delivery: TOL vs. eRCS
cohort: 1906 singleton pregnancies in women without a previous vaginal delivery who delivered at 24(+0) weeks to 36(+6) weeks gestation
finding: A trial of labor in preterm patients without a previous vaginal delivery was not found to be significantly associated with increased neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Neonates born to women undergoing a TOL had a decreased risk of proven/suspected sepsis compared with patients who underwent eRCS.
